# PoloSim Germany eSIM

> Country site for prepaid Germany travel eSIMs by PoloSim (polosim.com).
> Data plans that work across Germany (and the wider Europe region) are listed
> with live prices; purchase is completed on polosim.com. Content is in German.

## Key facts

- Plans covering Germany: fixed data packages (1GB–20GB) and Unlimited, validity 1–30 days
- Prices in EUR, fetched live from the PoloSim catalogue (typically from ~€1.88)
- Instant delivery by QR code, activation in ~5 minutes, no roaming fees
- Data-only, hotspot/tethering allowed, 4G/LTE speeds
- Buying: each plan links directly into the polosim.com cart
